items.title: Show HN: RunNburn – Run a 295B Moe from a 98GB GGUF on a 64GB RAM Desktop
items.summary: runNburn is an Apache-2.0 Rust inference engine for quantized GGUF models that are too big for your fast memory. The core idea: weights stay file-backed (mmap), host residency stays under an explicit byte budget (--ram-budget), and GPU caches are sized from detected free/total VRAM — never from device-name presets.
